content: DST transitions break fixed-width time bucketing: spring-forward creates a nonexistent local hour (crashes naive localization, e.g. 2:30 AM doesn't exist), fall-back duplicates an hour (creates fake 'spike' in charts as two real hours collapse into one bucket). Recommended fix: process/store in UTC, only convert to local time at display/query time; for local-day bucketing, compute the local-date UTC boundary explicitly rather than using fixed 24h offsets. Daily buckets can tolerate some 'clumping' (23h/25h days) but sub-day buckets (hourly) cannot.
